# Issue templates

Forms for bug reports, feature requests and project questions.

## Contents

- [bug_report.yml](bug_report.yml): the bug report file.
- [config.yml](config.yml): the config file.
- [feature_request.yml](feature_request.yml): the feature request file.
- [question.yml](question.yml): the question file.

## Entry point

Start with [feature_request.yml](feature_request.yml).
